title: Add support for missing DPoE and IEEE 1904.1 OAM attributes
description:
DPoE
- D-ONU Packet Buffer (0xD7000A)

IEEE 1904.1
- aReadWriteMACAddress (0x07/0x00-1D)
- aPhyType (0x07/0x00-20)
- aAutoNegotiationAdminState (0X07/0x00-4F)
- aMACControlFunctionsSupported (0x07/0x00-5D)
- acConfigMulticastLlid (0xD9/0x01-07)

notes.body: In this case, the two possible values are disabled(1) and enabled(2). I believe this means that a tfs_ value cannot be used since tfs_ expect values of 0 and 1.

changed this line in [version 2 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/8967/diffs?diff_id=547081833&start_sha=217bdab4f5740ee087ee8ee563e2baa8de60ff9b#f2a8b7534458e0aeb46b0927a49d475e2bc579a4_2082_2082)

changed this line in [version 2 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/8967/diffs?diff_id=547081833&start_sha=217bdab4f5740ee087ee8ee563e2baa8de60ff9b#f2a8b7534458e0aeb46b0927a49d475e2bc579a4_2491_2491)

can you look also

`packet-oampdu.c:1757 proto_tree_add_item called for hf_oam_dpoe_user_port_object_result_rr_queue_obj_type  -  item type is FT_UINT8 but call has len 2`
Fixed. The definition of the hf_oam_dpoe_user_port_object_result_rr_queue_obj_type variable was not correct. It was defined as FT_UINT8, but the DPoE specification says that this value is FT_UINT16.
